219139.description:
The 2024 Daimansai marks the 20th installment of the commemorative Kidan series, returning to its roots with Shouji Hashimoto, author of the first installment, "Yuurei Kanja."

This volume includes the title story "Danmatsuma" by Saburou Tsuyuki (Gorou Sugimoto) featuring a cover by Shigeru Mizuki. It's a story filled with screams from start to finish, featuring a mad criminal psychologist—taken from the collected volume, "Kiseijin." It's known within Togetsu Shobou as one of the hardest to find titles with the highest concentration of "Togetsu-ness."

Next in the collection is “Norowareta Shison,” a hidden work by Hashimoto which was originally published in the collection "Kaidan Ishikozume" (怪談石子詰, Togetsu Shobou) under his real name and the pseudonym Kiyoshi Tanigawa. Second is "Norowareta Shison," a timeless revenge drama.

Finally, three short to medium-length stories from Raigoro-chan—Shouji Hashimoto’s take on the legend of Momotaro, in which Goro-chan, the boy of thunder, punishes evil people. While not strictly a horror story, it is uniquely and extraordinarily unconventional.

Will Yvette be able to overcome rejection and misunderstandings to build a true family with them? And moreover, what is the hidden truth behind this marriage of convenience...?

219141.description:
This volume collects two horror manga drawn for Togetsu Shobou by Goro Sugimoto (1924–1987, under the pen name Tsuyuki Saburou)—a legendary film collector with deep ties to Shigeru Mizuki.

1. Kiseijin (寄生人) [circa 1961, Togetsu Shobou]
“Shigeru Mizuhara is a young reporter for a third-rate weekly magazine. On his way to work, as he was daydreaming about how nice it would be to live a life of leisure if he were a twin, he was stopped by an old woman claiming to be a fortune-teller. When he peered into the crystal ball she held out, he saw a double image of himself, and the old woman told him that his wish would come true, albeit in a different form. That day, for some reason, his leg began to ache, and when he returned home early from work, a human face had appeared on his left knee. It was a “parasite”—a monster that had entered his body through his nose when he peered into the crystal ball, and was now growing by feeding on his blood. The parasite says it will be reborn as his twin, but what will become of Shigeru Mizuhara...?

2. Miira-jima (ミイラ島) [circa 1962, Togetsu Shobou]
Summer vacation was just around the corner. A notice recruiting elementary school students for part-time work was posted at a school in Arakawa Ward. It was a job organizing books at the Rockefeller Library, and a male teacher from the school was tasked with chaperoning as many as 150 students. However, the male teacher grew suspicious of the foreign interviewer’s attitude when he went to apply for the job, as well as the method used to split the students up and move them separately. The teacher and the children traveled by boat from Yokosuka to a small island in the Seto Inland Sea. There, the task assigned to the children was to read books one after another. Two weeks later, five children returned home each day, but according to a maid, five wooden crates were delivered to the island the very next day. In fact, the wooden boxes contained the mummified heads of children...

(Source: Kaiki Manga no Anagura, translated)

"I heard the Duke of Blantiger, who came down from the North, is looking for a babysitter!"

However, the Duke of Blantiger is known as the King of the North, a man with such immense power that even the Imperial Family dares not cross him. If she sets foot in such a terrifying ducal household, she's sure to end up in a world of trouble. No matter how badly she needs money, she can't risk her life!

"The salary is 500 gold."

Lured by the enormous salary, Lulubell soon finds herself working at the ducal estate. But looking after a baby tiger isn't enough. She's also asked to become the Duke's fake fiancée?! What began as a job she took solely for the money has turned into both childcare and a fake engagement. Follow Lulubell, the little squirrel, as she stumbles her way through life in the ducal household! Will Lulubell manage to collect her paycheck and return to her peaceful everyday life in one piece?

219338.description:
After South Korea’s economy collapsed, human rights for criminals are no longer respected in the chaotic society that followed. “Deep Fence” is an app created to force them to host adult live streams and raise capital. Private First Class Yu Ju-Heon, on leave for the first time in a long while, uploads a photo of himself in his military uniform to the app as a joke, and, elated by the substantial donation of $3,000, drinks with a friend until they’re both completely drunk. The next day, Ju-Heon wakes up with a terrible hangover before returning to duty and checks the notification from the app...

“Are you really a soldier? I can see your face and even your rank insignia—I’m going to report you.”

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

"Can I be selfish just one last time?"

Instead, Tasuku spent his days watching from afar, as Raito made a name for himself as a professional baseball player. Yet suddenly, Raito quits the team and disappears without a trace - until Tasuku, worrying about what happened, runs into him at a former baseball club reunion...

219345.description:
A brilliant lawyer was working late into the night on a case when something strange catches his eye. His hands are becoming transparent...?! He dismisses it as exhaustion, but the transparency creeps up his arms until... He suddenly finds himself in an unknown world. In a room resembling an ancient castle, he was unsettled by the dim, eerie light. When a strange voice called out, "Lord Zofi," he turned to face it. Looking into the mirror, he was stunned to see... A tail? Horns? And these scandalously revealing clothes?! Wait... Is this me?!

He soon learns he's in the demon realm, having switched souls with Zofi, an incubus next in line to be the Demon Lord. Before he can even process this revelation, a formidable demon named Belial, who practically embodies the word "monster," pins him down. Kudou must adapt to his new life as an incubus, including their unique dietary needs and the strange demon culture. His only chance of returning home is a joint scheme with Belial to make him the new Demon Lord instead. But maybe things won't go quite as planned...?

(Source: Eiwa Publishing, translated)

219368.description:
In addition to its regular divisions, the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department’s Criminal Investigation Division had a unit called Special Investigation Section 0, which brought together maverick detectives. Takuma Date, a martial arts master, and Kikuchiyo Tokumaru, an unrivaled womanizer, both members of Section 0, were known as the “Violence Express” due to their reckless actions. Riding in their specially modified, armed patrol car, the “Violence,” they crushed criminals.

This police action series depicts the exploits of a duo who, were it not for their title as detectives, would simply be terrorists. It has the feel of a “Western Police” series that was ahead of its time. In short, any characters the protagonist (the author) dislikes are mercilessly taken down.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

219369.description:
Go Itagaki was hitchhiking his way to Haneda. Around that time, a boat had capsized at sea, and the Japan Coast Guard’s Special Rescue Team had been dispatched, but they were unable to carry out the rescue due to high waves and bad weather. That was when Go Itagaki arrived and successfully completed the difficult rescue. Go Itagaki was the new member joining the Special Rescue Team.

A rescue action manga featuring the Special Rescue Team.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

219370.description:
Shinichi Yamada, who came from Tokyo to a rural orphanage, discovers a crashed Cessna plane in the mountains with his friends. A suitcase full of money and guns is also found there, and one of his friends takes the money and buys a car. However, members of the secret organization "G," who own the suitcase, appear and attack not only his friend but also the orphanage. Just when it seems there is no way to stop this group that commits murder without hesitation, Shinichi reveals his true nature. Shinichi is a former member of the secret organization "G," and with his trained movements, he takes down the members of "G." This is an action manga about a man raised by a secret organization.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

219371.description:
Among a herd of Triceratops, a young Triceratops named Al, who was born with a white coat, was shunned by his peers because his distinctive color made the herd an easy target for predators. Amidst this, Al befriended Mono, another Triceratops who was also shunned by the others because he had only a single horn. However, the herd was attacked by a giant Tyrannosaurus known as the “Fang King.” While nearly the entire herd was wiped out, Al managed to survive thanks to Mono’s self-sacrificing resistance, but Mono perished. Determined to avenge Mono’s death, Al sets out on a journey to find the legendary three-horned dinosaur that Mono had told him about.

A dinosaur adventure manga set in the world of dinosaurs.

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

219373.description:
In the early 1970s, the CB750four was said to be the fastest motorcycle in the world at the time. Its top speed of 200 km/h meant that it was a life-or-death situation. Jiro, who came to Tokyo alone from Okinawa, works as a taxi driver, feeling anger, frustration, and anxiety as his beloved hometown is ravaged by American soldiers, and seeks solace in his nightly rides...!? A Showa-era coming-of-age motorcycle romance comic by the author of "Kirin"!

(Source: Shonen Gahosha, translated)

219374.description:
Tenes, the illegitimate son of a high-ranking nobleman, grows up ostracized and isolated, but the only one who treats him kindly as family is Fiona, the daughter of the legitimate wife. However, a tears them apart... Labeled incompetent, Tenes is banished to the countryside, and Fiona becomes embroiled in a succession struggle for the emperor's throne.

"I will protect her no matter what."

With the skills of a [Hermit] abandoned by the gods and his quick wit, he challenges the twisted rules that plague the world, together with his strongest companions. A dull, errand-running boy—but actually, he is the mastermind behind a dark organization plotting to overthrow the world (?)!!

Kanaki Taiga is the school nurse and teacher at Celevess Magic School. While taking good care of his students who adore him, he also likes to spend time on his hobby; torturing and killing. When the magical prodigy princess Karen Holks Ortesia and her bodyguard Fina transfer to his school, Kanaki picks Fina as his next victim. Lacherie, the daughter of a fallen noble family, lived a modest life as a governess. One day, her uncle Rudolf approached her with a request: "I want you to educate the current king, who is notorious as a tyrant, for the sake of the country."

Lacherie, disguised as the king's fiancée, Sophia, entered the palace, only to be met with the tyrant Jill pointing his sword at her and ordering her to "get out," before disappearing during class time. "I was prepared to be ignored, but he won't even come to my lessons!"

After remembering his past life, Muscular discovers that he has been reincarnated as a character from a game he loved in his previous life.
However, he was reincarnated as a physically specialized, muscle-brained character who becomes less useful during the latter half of the game?!

Yuta, who lives in Naga on the outskirts of Nanosland, rides an elderly Pachycephalosaurus named Jisama to the meeting place to apply for a job as a guide for a Navy caravan. Although it seemed impossible given Jisama’s slow pace, Yuta was successfully hired and begins working alongside his childhood friend Phil and the others. However, on the way, they encounter a Tyrannosaurus that shouldn’t have been there, and the slow-moving Jisama becomes the Tyrannosaurus’s target. Yuta, who had been hired specifically for this very situation, finds himself in a life-or-death crisis, but for some reason, he begins to hear Jisama’s voice. By following its advice, he succeeds in fending off the Tyrannosaurus.

An adventure drama manga set in a world where dinosaurs and humans live together, following the growth of a young dinosaur handler.

Half a year had passed since the Battle of Typan Pass, and while the King of the Underworld’s army continued its westward advance, King of the Underworld Marta’s true objective was not to recapture the Sea Kingdom, but to secure the person believed to be in the Mountain Kingdom to the west, the one capable of communicating with the “key” dragon. The King of the Underworld’s army sent Lance and others, so-called “Human-like” beings, said to be born once in tens of thousands, to enter the country disguised as “humans.” A new battle centered on Yuta Pai Ron was about to begin.

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

219395.description:
Sousuke Kusanagi, who is overwhelmingly strong in a fight and frustrated by the lack of opponents, was about to pick a fight with some yakuza when his teacher, Munakata, stopped him. Seeing that Sousuke was so restless he didn’t know what to do, Munakata introduced him to a dojo run by his relative, Takada. Upon arriving at the dojo, Sousuke immediately picked a fight with a student and beat him up, but the student didn’t seem to feel a thing. In fact, Sousuke ended up getting hit with a knee strike, but he managed to break free using sheer brute strength. Realizing he wouldn’t stand a chance if he got injured, Sosuke was eventually taken down with a sleeper hold. Excited by encountering such strength, Sosuke decided to embark on the path of mixed martial arts.

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

High school students Yazu and Sudou were best friends who would sometimes stay over at each other’s houses or skip school together to go to the beach. Yazu dreamed of becoming a fashion designer and wanted to join the high school’s sewing club, but he was hesitant because there was only one other boy in the club. So, Sudou decided to join the club too, giving Yazu the encouragement he needed to take the plunge. A coming-of-age school drama manga set in the world of fashion.

The exciting events recounted in this book include:

•How and why Musashi wrote The Book of Five Rings, a revolutionary work that has become the most widely-read book on swordsmanship and Samurai strategy ever written
•The important lessons he provides including the idea of "no mind", or what we now call "flow", which involves endless practice emptying your mind of thoughts to move intuitively without thinking

However, in reality, his heart's been closed off ever since his college relationship fell apart because of one mistake. As his mind is plagued with worry, wondering if he'll let his past relationship control his entire life, he spots Rui, his ex from across the street one day. Against his better judgment, Rokuro begins walking by that street daily, just to get a glance at his past lover.

A bitter love story of two men, and the anguish and torment they experience over their once-lost relationship.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title.native: 涙の音

219614.description:
Kanae Sakura lives with his university's folklore studies professor, Tsubaki. In exchange for free room and board, he helps out at the bar that Tsubaki runs - a bar that caters only to supernatural spirits. Crazy, right? However, everyone has secrets. Even Kanae.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

title.native: 佐倉叶にはヒミツがある
title.romaji: Sakura Kanae ni wa Himitsu ga Aru

219615.description:
The innocent looking school teacher, Nao is in a loving relationship with his handsome boyfriend, Ryota. For their one year anniversary, Ryota prepared a special present for him. Waiting alone at the park in the dark, Nao is accosted! It turns out, it's all a part of Ryota's cuckold fetish! Nao always folds to Ryota's whims and desires, but can their relationship handle the strain of Ryota's domineering personality?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: NTR(寝取られ)えっち

219617.description:
College student Kuki looks like a player at first glance, and his history of being dumped by girlfriends for his high sex drive isn't helping his case. When he bumps into his classmate, Yukina, one day and tries to hand back the guy's fallen earbud, he gets a "Let go! Pervert!" for his troubles. Now Kuki's worried he might have offended Yukina somehow, but when he tries to find out what he did and apologize, it's like talking to a brick wall. In the end, Yukina flat-out runs away from him and Kuki is now positive the guy hates his guts... until they run into each other at a bar one night and Yukina does a 180, diving in to kiss Kuki out of nowhere. Seeing the frosty Yukina so needy and disheveled is too much for Kuki to resist and it's only a matter of minutes until they're going at it in a nearby hotel. It's the best sex Kuki's ever had - so good that he passes out from the bliss (if you can believe it). And if that wasn't enough excitement for one night, Yukina drops a bombshell on him once he wakes up...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: スノウメルトシンドローム

219619.description:
Sora is an orphaned human, living on the outskirts of a land run by beast people. One day, while working in the brothel, Sora is to service a lycan thrope. It was the first time Sora had ever seen these people he had admired growing up, but upon meeting this Lycan named Navras he is called "disgusting"... sending him into a rant of frustration. Leaving the room without taking the money leaves him in conflict with the manager but suddenly this Lycan seems interested in him...? After receiving enough money to go without working for the next month, Sora begins to wonder... when will he be able to see this Lycan again?

(Source: MangaPlaza)
synonyms: ライカン ―伯爵獣と囚われた男娼―
Lycan Thrope: The Beast Count and his Entrapped Prostitute
ライカン ―伯爵獣に愛された男娼―
Lycan Thrope: The Beast Count and his Beloved Prostitute
ライカン－伯爵獣に愛された伴侶－
Lycan Thrope: The Beast Count and his Beloved Partner
ライカン―氷の伯爵と博愛の半狼―
Lycan: Koori no Hakushaku to Hakuai no Han Ookami

title.native: ライカン―伯爵獣と囚われた男娼―

synonyms: ライカン－黒狼子爵に囚われた貴族－

title.native: ライカン―黒狼子爵に囚われた貴族―
title.romaji: Lycan: Kuro Ookami Shishaku ni Torawareta Kizoku

219622.description:
"I'm not giving up until you love me back. I hope you're prepared."

Kagami has been known to be charming but hasn't had any luck dating since his issues with ED have started. This time around, he's waiting on someone who matched with him after he changed his profile description to more honestly state that he's inexperienced. However, the person that shows up isn't some woman but none other than his frustrating rival he's known since high school: Kamitani. Kamitani and Kagami have been friends for the longest time, but Kamitani always seems to outdo him and tease him over all sorts of things. Now that Kamitani's well-aware of what Kagami's been up to with dating apps, it feels like he's got another angle to take advantage of... but something new seems to be developing between the two...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Notes:
- Originally self-published on Pixiv, was then licensed by Kaiohsha for commercial release.
- Chapter 7 was not compiled into a volume.
- Includes five extra chapters.

title.english: I Will Not Be Fooled by the Lying Wolf!
title.native: 嘘つきオオカミには騙されない！
キスは捜査のあとで ファイナル
title.romaji: Kiss wa Sousa no Ato de: Final

title.native: 촬영 중입니다

219625.description: Chiharu Hiiragi repeated a year and is struggling to fit in with his class. While taking remedial chemistry in the infirmary, the person sitting next to him turns out to be a super shy classmate covered in a bedsheet. Wearing a ghost-like sheet, her face is hidden, and her conversations are awkward. Yet, for some reason, being with her feels comforting. Things about their age, about school, and the secrets they can't quite put into words... As they slowly share more conversations, their time after school begins to change. A slightly awkward, a little off-beat, passing-grade and clumsy after-school youth comedy starting from the infirmary, begins!
synonyms: Even Repeaters Want to Enjoy Youth

title.native: 及第点でも青春を!

219628.description:
One day, a hardcore completionist of the incredibly complex, multi-ending RPG Ronzorkia finds himself reincarnated into the game's world. Worse yet, he has been reborn as Hollow von Heisenberg... a lazy, arrogant villain fated to die in absolutely every route. "If I don't change things, the game's 'scenario' is going to murder me...!" There is only one way to survive. He must weaponize the exhaustive game knowledge from his past life, completely master Hollow's unique magic, and become the most overpowered existence in this world. His first step? It's becoming the apprentice of his master swordsman butler...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: The Scum Noble Dominates by Humbly Grinding: Using Meta-Knowledge and the Unique Magic to Dodge the Bad End

title.native: 極悪貴族、謙虚堅実に無双する ～原作知識と固有魔法＜虚空＞を駆使して、破滅エンドを回避します～
title.romaji: Gokuaku Kizoku, Kenkyo Kenjitsu ni Musou suru: Gensaku Chishiki to Koyuu Mahou "Kokuu" wo Kushi shite, Hametsu End wo Kaihi shimasu

219629.description:
"To protect the young lady he loves, he will NTR the princess generals of the enemy nation!"

The strongest spy of the modern world is reincarnated in another world as a butler serving a weak noble family. Deep in his heart he holds his feelings for his kind-hearted mistress and his vow to protect the homeland she loves.

However, the beautiful princess generals of a neighboring nation boasting overwhelming military power begin their invasion. Faced with a hopeless difference in military strength, the man makes a decision: abandon honorable warfare and operate as a ruthless spy, infiltrating the enemy and devouring them from within. He will tear apart their bonds, break their hearts, and use the skill granted to him—"honey trap"—to NTR the enemy princess generals!

(Source: Takecomic, translated)

title.native: 異世界NTR戦争

219630.description:
Lord Nord... Would you like some morning milk from my breasts?"

I was reincarnated into the adult game I had been playing moments ago, The Rising Hero's Academy Harem Domination. But I wasn't reincarnated as the hero protagonist. Instead, I became Nord, the villainous heir who steals the hero's main heroine, the Earl's daughter Elise, only to be killed at the end of the story. I can't afford to leisurely drink milk from a maid's breasts! I need to avoid my death flags and live a peaceful, slow-paced life, so I do everything I can to stay away from Elise. But somehow, everything I do makes Elise misunderstand my intentions, and my affection rating with her just keeps going up...

"Please, have a look at my untouched body..."

She's fallen completely in love with me, volunteered to become my personal maid, and now she's coming to my room every night!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: The Villainous Heir Who Avoided His Downfall, Only to Be Pursued by the Heroine, I Became the Villainous Heir, but the Heroine Won't Leave Me Alone

title.native: エロゲの伯爵令嬢を奉仕メイド堕ちさせる悪役御曹司に転生した俺はざまぁを回避する
title.romaji: Eroge no Hakushaku Reijou wo Houshi Maid Ochisaseru Akuyaku Onzoushi ni Tensei shita Ore wa Zamaa wo Kaihi suru

title.native: Barありさかへようこそ！
恋に至る病

219634.description:
Roik, a vile orphanage director who runs the orphanage solely for money, suddenly remembers that he is a reincarnated person! This is the world of a game he played in his previous life, and a future awaits him in which he is ruined after being killed by Alice, one of the orphanage’s children, who seeks revenge against him— “I almost envy Roik for living however he pleased…” After dying in his previous life due to a friend’s betrayal, Roik decides that, since he’s a villain, he’ll live however he wants. However, for some reason, the children begin looking up to him as their Papa, and he ends up forming a deep bond with them as a family…?! A heartwarming fantasy where he is loved and adored by the daughters of the main heroines proudly begins!!

(Source: Manga Zegra, translated)
synonyms: Reincarnated as the Villainous Orphanage Director Destined to Be Defeated, I Ended Up Being Loved by the Main Heroines’ Daughters

title.native: やられ役の悪徳孤児院長に転生した俺、メインヒロインの娘達に好かれてしまう
title.romaji: Yarare Yaku no Akutoku Kojiinchou ni Tensei shita Ore, Main Heroine no Musumetachi ni Sukareteshimau

title.native: 今日だけやからな！

219636.description:
In modern times, marriage between humans and yokai has become possible. Jinjin, a poverty god, works as a matchmaker at a graveyard matchmaking agency. One day, a middle school girl named Tsuyako comes seeking his help...?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: 妖怪結婚相談所

219637.description:
Abandoned by her parents at a young age, Elsie grew up in a convent and is a nun-in-training who loves God. She enjoys her daily life in the convent, but one day her father suddenly appears and makes an unreasonable demand: "If you don't want the donations to the convent to be cut off, you must take your sister's place and live in the royal palace as a candidate for the king's consort." To protect the convent she loves, Elsie becomes a candidate for consort. She is bewildered by her unfamiliar life, and the king is a scary man, but... as long as she can pray to God, everything will be alright! The chaotic royal palace life of a carefree, tomboyish nun begins!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 元シスター令嬢の身代わりお妃候補生活 ～神様に無礼な人はこの私が許しません～
title.romaji: Moto Sister Reijou no Migawari Okisaki Kouho Seikatsu: Kamisama ni Burei na Hito wa Kono Watashi ga Yurushimasen

synonyms: I Reincarnated as the Villainous Noble Destined to Be Destroyed by the Trash Hero Party, but I'll Crush Them Completely With My Knowledge of the Original Story and Hard Work

title.native: クズ勇者パーティーに破滅させられる悪役貴族に転生したけど、原作知識と努力で完膚なきまでに叩き潰します
title.romaji: Kuzu Yuusha Party ni Hametsu Saserareru Akuyaku Kizoku ni Tensei Shita kedo, Gensaku Chishiki to Doryoku de Kanpunaki made ni Tataki Tsubushimasu.

219639.description:
Hugh Pnosis is a young boy burdened with the memories of his past life as an overworked corporate drone. All he wants in this new world is to live a carefree, easygoing life. However, the power he’s granted is the "Brainwashing" skill... an ability that allows him to absolutely dominate anyone he chooses! Without the guts to even entertain thoughts like, "I'll brainwash beautiful women and build a harem!", Hugh resolves to never abuse his terrifying power and vows to keep it an absolute secret. But he soon discovers a completely broken, cheat-level loophole: by casting on himself, he can freely rewrite and swap out his own skills at will?!

(Source: Comic Gardo, translated)
synonyms: Overpowered in Another World with a Brainwashing Skill?!: I’ll Be Executed If I’m Found Out, so I Tried to Live an Honest Life… But Now I’m Surrounded by Beautiful Girls?!

title.native: 洗脳スキルで異世界無双!? ～スキルがバレたら処刑されるので健全誠実に生きようとしたら、なぜか美少女たちに愛されている件について～
title.romaji: Sennou Skill de Isekai Musou!? Skill ga Baretara Shokei sareru node Kenzen Seijitsu ni Ikiyou to Shitara, Nazeka Bishoujo tachi ni Aisareteiru Ken ni Tsuite

title.native: 洗脳スキルで異世界無双!? ～スキルがバレたら処刑されるので健全誠実に生きようとしたら、なぜか美少女たちに愛されている件について～
title.romaji: Sennou Skill de Isekai Musou!? Skill ga Baretara Shokei sareru node Kenzen Seijitsu ni Ikiyou to Shitara, Nazeka Bishoujo tachi ni Aisareteiru Ken ni Tsuite

synonyms: The Hero Returning From Another World Has Too Much Sex Appeal, so He Embraces All the Heat-Stricken Heroines According to His Desires

title.native: 異世界帰りの英雄は性的魅力〈スキル〉も強すぎるので発情ヒロイン全員を欲望のまま抱いていく
title.romaji: Isekai-gaeri no Eiyuu wa Skill mo Tsuyosugiru node Hatsujou Heroine Zenin wo Yokubou no Mama Daiteiku

219642.description:
Lilina, who works at the Adventurers' Guild in town, is a stunningly beautiful and kind receptionist who is immensely popular with everyone. Yet for some reason, she treats only Rex, a newly registered adventurer, with cold indifference, leaving him feeling dejected.

But the truth is, she simply gets awkward because she likes Rex far, far too much...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: Ms. Lilina, the Guild Receptionist, Is Cold Only to Me.

title.native: ギルドの受付嬢リリナさんは俺にだけ冷たい
title.romaji: Guild no Uketsukejou Lilina-san wa Ore ni dake Tsumetai

219643.description:
Obsessive love and madness are separated by a very fine line. A romantic horror story about pure love drowning in a twisted form of love. Yoito was at the height of happiness after finally starting a relationship with his childhood friend, Nana. However, his peaceful days with the girl who loved him for who he truly was, without any ulterior motives, suddenly came crashing down after an accident. After witnessing Nana’s death, Yoito completely loses his composure. “I can save that girl for you.” Then, a mysterious woman suddenly appears and, to his horror, begins devouring Nana’s corpse… Is what this strange woman brings salvation, or an even worse hell? A twisted tale of horror and romance begins, where pure love and obsessive love intertwine!

(Source: Drecomi, transated)
synonyms: Fascinated by a Beautiful Dead Face

title.native: 可愛い死顔に魅せられて

219644.description:
College student Souta Akizuki is swept overboard during a violent storm and believes his life is over. When he awakens, he finds himself stranded on a mysterious island in another world.

There, he learns that men are extraordinarily rare—only one is born for every thousand people. Because of this imbalance, the Kingdom and the Empire wage endless wars over men. In this strange world, men avoid women while women desperately seek them, creating a deeply distorted social order.

Trying to conceal his true circumstances, Souta acts as he normally would, only to discover that his very "normality" is what makes him extraordinary. In a world where a man's sexual desire itself is treated as an overwhelming advantage, he begins captivating one strong and beautiful woman after another.

(Source: Kill Time Communication, translated)
synonyms: Swept Away to a Reversed World: The Harem Life of a Rare Man Surviving in an Alternate World

title.native: 逆転世界に流されて ～男が希少な異世界で生き抜くハーレムライフ～
title.romaji: Gyakuten Sekai ni Nagasarete: Otoko ga Kishou na Isekai de Ikinuku Harem Life

219645.description:
A girl selling her body right here at school——

The rumor goes that if you pay her, she'll let you do anything. That's the talk surrounding Hadzuki Mio, the girl who sits next to me—but she doesn't look the type at all……! Her voice is incredibly small, she's taciturn to begin with, she won't even make eye contact when I speak to her…… and her chest's small, too.

Just as I was thinking the rumors were nothing more than idle gossip, I saw it happen in an empty classroom after school. I witnessed the very moment she was selling her body to a boy… What's more, her demeanor was completely different from how she acts in class; despite the nature of the act, she wore a sweet, tender expression—like a girl newly in love……

title.native: 今日もわたしのこと買う？
title.romaji: Kyou mo Watashi no Koto Kau?

219646.description:
The second one-shot comic adaptation of the animated film "GROTESQQQUE"!

In the city of GALs TOKYO where morning never comes, the "Leopard Sisters" are active in a game called QoB, but who are they really...?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: Young Panther 19 Buchigillle Knowing

219647.description:
The Fols family was a prestigious lineage of swordsmen and influential nobles who ruled the southern part of the country. Nova, born the third son, was deemed a failure for lacking the unique power of his bloodline, and his childhood was far from easy. As an adult, he was granted a small territory, but expectations from his family and peers were virtually nonexistent. Then, unexpectedly, a marriage proposal arrived from the powerful Arkgate family, rulers of the north and long-time rivals of the Fols. The bride-to-be was none other than Shea, the head of the Arkgate family herself. "I've loved you ever since that time…" she confessed. And so, the man who had nothing would wed a woman who was kind, beautiful, and remarkable in every way, a wife who would change his fate entirely. "They say the head of the Arkgate family is terrifying, heartless, and cruel," but Shea is sweet, intelligent, and perfect. With Nova's easygoing nature and Shea revealing her true self only to him, their married life began.

(Source: Comic Ryu, translated)
synonyms: I Married the Head of My Archenemy’s Household: My Wife Is Cute, Fragile, Kind, Smart, Adorable, and Simply the Best

title.native: 宿敵の家の当主を妻に貰いました ～妻は可憐で儚くて優しくて賢くて可愛くて最高です～
title.romaji: Shukuteki no Ie no Toushu wo Tsuma ni Moraimashita: Tsuma wa Karen de Hakanakute Yasashikute Kashikokute Kawaikute Saikou desu

219648.description:
Luke has reincarnated as a mob prince from a game he played in his past life. In this world, there is Diana, the cutest little sister in the world. As it turns out, Diana is fated to die after falling into darkness. His beloved little sister will die at the end of a dark path? Luke is determined to smash that scenario to pieces. He has been striving ever since he was a baby to defy that fate. This is the story of a mob prince aiming to become the strongest to protect his beloved little sister.

(Source: MangaPoke, translated)
synonyms: Reborn as the Mob Villain Prince Destined to Die Before the Game Begins: I Turned My Weakest Magic [Dark Edge] Into the Most Broken Skill Through Sheer Effort

title.native: ゲーム開始前に死ぬモブ悪役皇子に転生した俺　～推しヒロインの妹と幸せになるために最弱魔法【闇刃】を過剰な努力で極め抜いたら、最強のぶっ壊れ性能と化していた件～
title.romaji: Game Kaishi Mae ni Shinu Mob Akuyaku Ouji ni Tensei shita Ore: Oshi Heroine no Imouto to Shiawase ni Naru Tame ni Saijaku Mahou "Dark Edge" wo Kajou na Doryoku de Kiwamenuitara, Saikyou no Bukkoware Seinou to Kashiteita Ken

219649.description:
The lone flower that brightens up the office—Yamamori Mutsuko. Secretly, she has a quiet crush on her boss... But hold on—aren't her approaches a bit too extreme!? An age gap solved with "energy-boost meals"!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: むつ子、精をつけます！

219650.description:
Theo is a solo adventurer cursed with the "loner" curse, which makes it impossible for him to form a party with anyone. While visiting the remote frontier town of Disbule, where succubi are rumored to be attacking the locals, he gathers information at a tavern. There, he meets Lilya, a young woman dressed in elegant, noble attire that seems completely out of place. After Theo rescues her from a group of drunken men harassing her, she offers to repay him by saying, "I'll... do something naughty for you," and starts taking off her clothes...!?

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)
synonyms: The Clumsy Succubus and the Cursed Loner Adventurer

title.native: んこつサキュバスとぼっち呪いの冒険者 ～なぜかドジっ子淫魔と無双する!～
title.romaji: Ponkotsu Succubus to Bocchi Noroi no Boukensha: Nazeka Dojikko Inma to Musou suru!

219651.description:
Randolph Victor, once a Japanese man, finds himself reincarnated in a world that feels like a familiar video game. Following his own interests, he trains diligently until an unexpected event reveals the truth: this is actually an otome game. To make matters more ironic, he’s just a nameless background noble. But things take a surprising turn when Randolph ends up rescuing the villainess who was meant to be exiled from the kingdom.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: I Was Just a Mob, but I Picked up a Villainess: Ignoring the Main Story and Enjoying Myself as I Please

title.native: モブの俺が悪役令嬢を拾ったんだが ～ゲーム本編無視で、好き勝手楽しみます～
title.romaji: Mob no Ore ga Akuyaku Reijou wo Hirottan daga: Game Honpen Mushi de, Suki Katte Tanoshimimasu

219652.description:
Twenty years have passed since the Demon King was defeated. Raina, who had once been summoned as a Hero but lacked the talent for the sword—leaving him able only to watch his companions set off on their journey—now works alone in the royal capital as an archer, ceaselessly picking off monsters. Then, a young girl named Ariana appears before him as the new Hero, bringing news that the Demon King is poised to return. Burdened by regrets from his past, this middle-aged archer rises up once more—this time as a true Hero and a guardian of humanity!!

(Source: Young Champion, translated)
synonyms: The Middle-Aged Archer Who Couldn't Become a Hero Becomes the Guardian of Mankind

title.native: 勇者になれなかったおっさん弓兵、人類の守護者となる
title.romaji: Yuusha ni Narenakatta Ossan Kyuuhei, Jinrui no Shugosha to Naru

219653.description:
Senei Academy, the only educational institution capable of granting supernatural abilities to people. The ability possessed by Yuuto Amamori is 【The ability to worsen eyesight】―that overly weak ability is just a camouflage, as he was a special existence possessing the strongest ability before even enrollment.

(Source: Takecomic, translated)
synonyms: The Strongest in the Supernatural School Lurks in Peace - The Extraordinary Monster Pretends to Be Incompetent and Controls the Academy From the Shadows

title.native: 異能学園の最強は平穏に潜む～規格外の怪物、無能を演じ学園を影から支配する～
title.romaji: Inou Gakuen no Saikyou wa Heion ni Hisomu: Kikakugai no Kaibutsu, Munou wo Enji Gakuen wo Kage kara Shihai suru

title.native: ありふれた職業で世界最強 コミックアンソロジー
title.romaji: Arifureta Shokugyou de Sekai Saikyou Comic Anthology

219655.description:
Aoi Yuuto, the secret son of a nationally beloved popular actor, enrolls in the private Ichiyō High School, which has various departments. He just wants to enjoy a peaceful school life as an ordinary student in the academic department... so why won't the girls from the performing arts department leave him alone!? Because he's way too close with his childhood friend Hotta Akari, who dreams of becoming an idol, people start suspecting that he's her boyfriend. He also begins living next door to Minase Nagisa, a popular young actress his age, leading to a lively everyday life that easily attracts attention! On top of that, his father's genes are strong—his father was once called a “national treasure-level handsome man” in his youth— Thanks to his hidden good looks and his concealed talent for acting, he is assigned as Nagisa's partner for the performing arts department entrance exam!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: I Just Want a Normal School Life, but the Performing Arts Girls Won't Leave Me Alone

title.native: 一般人の俺を芸能科女子達が逃がしてくれない件。
title.romaji: Ippanjin no Ore wo Geinou-ka Joshitachi ga Nigashite Kureinai Ken.

219656.description:
I had been reincarnated as the leader of a villain party in an exile-type anime. Just as I was about to exile the story's protagonist, in order to avoid the death route where I'd get my comeuppance just like in the anime, I decided to exile myself instead!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: I Reincarnated as the Leader of a Villain Party, So I Kicked Myself Out Before the Revenge Plot Could Begin

title.native: 追放系の悪役パーティのリーダーに転生したので、ざまぁされる前に自分を追放しました。 ～スキルを奪う『スティール』って悪役過ぎるけど強すぎる～
title.romaji: Tsuihou-kei no Akuyaku Party no Leader ni Tensei shita node, Zamaa sareru Mae ni Jibun wo Tsuihou shimashita. Skill wo Ubau "Steal" tte Akuyaku Sugiru kedo Tsuyosugiru

219657.description:
Lake, whose only skill is "curse dispelling," is denounced as useless by his party members, cast out of the party, and abandoned deep inside a dungeon. Stranded all alone in a dungeon teeming with monsters and facing a desperate situation, Lake somehow manages to stumble into a hidden room... And what he finds waiting for him there is none other than an SSS-rank item: "The Ring of the Curse Demon God"! When he immediately uses his curse-dispelling ability on it and equips the ring, a beautiful silver-haired girl named Miu emerges from it...!

(Source: Hifumi Shobo, translated)

The protagonist, Meiphite, the Great Saintess, hides her true bold and fearless nature and instead plays the role of an ideal saint. Because of her outstanding abilities, she becomes the target of resentment and ostracism from the other saintesses. One day, Meiphite is falsely accused of attempting to assassinate another saintess. Unable to contain her anger, she goes on a rampage. Carried by that momentum, she sets off on a journey. Along the way, she encounters Gilliam, a beastman whose companions have been kidnapped, and the two decide to work together.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

After getting involved in a shady part-time job, our protagonist finds himself seated at the dinner table of a mysterious mansion...?! And the best spice to complement a delicious meal is... tales of other people's misfortunes?!

219750.description:
Tasuke and the moon spirit, Guardian Moon Goddess Shaorin, are now high school students. Three years have passed since they started living under the same roof, but their relationship remains that of "master" and "serving spirit"...? Many of the star gods, including the sun spirit, Keikou Nitten Ruuan, and the earth spirit, Bannan Chiten Kiryuu, are all back, just like in "Guardian Moon Goddess!" The usual boisterous daily life and the big developments (?) in Tasuke and Shaorin's love story!

(Source: Mag Garden, translated)

One ordinary day while taking care of a baby seal, the seal transformed into a handsome young man! His true identity is Hae-Gyeol, the youngest prince of the Sea Kingdom. Between helping Hae-Gyeol, who’s only been human for one day, adjust to his new life and juggling her day job, Yeo-Han is swamped… but he’s told that if he doesn’t find a mate for Hae-Gyeol, he’ll die?! Will Yeo-Han manage to survive this tangled web of fate? A story of Yeo-Han’s chaotic struggle to survive and Hae-Gyeol’s quest for love!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Yoshiba Mei is a first-year working professional with ASD (Autism Spectrum Disorder). Mei sees the world a little differently from those around her, and has a slight crush on Koeda, the cheerful and popular guy at the office. Determined to be useful to him, she throws herself into her work, relying on her natural ability to focus, but somehow keeps making mistakes. Seeing Mei feeling down, Koeda decides to share a secret just between the two of them—.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

219758.description:
Fatigued by a life of crushing expectations, corporate worker Yun-seo finds solace in an otome game. Then, a single update kickstarts a transmigration where she awakens as Lody Evant, the empire's infamous villainess. Abandoned by her ducal family, banished to a run-down shack, and hated by the locals, her prospects for survival appear grim. Her fortunes turn when she discovers a powerful in-game cheat: the ability to see everyone's darkest, most guarded secrets. Utilizing her business acumen, fearless confidence, and profitable extortion tactics, Lody takes charge to overturn her grim destiny and amass a vast fortune.

(Source: Tappytoon)

219759.description:
Nyx Farroah, Duke of Roundhill, won the war but lost all hope of being loved, his body left scarred and his heart resigned to solitude. Then his knight brings home a pagan apothecary, Titchte Ranlam—a beautiful woman Nyx never expected. For a man who gave up on being seen, it may be too late to look away.

(Source: Manta)

219760.description:
Every morning at the station, he sees Shiraishi Kotoha, a beautiful girl from another school. With her long honey-colored hair and loosely worn uniform, she's a top-tier gyaru who makes everyone stop and stare. Keitarou, a high school boy who once saved Kotoha from being secretly filmed, starts running into her on the platform every morning. She gives him sweet smiles, suddenly grabs his hand... Her sense of personal space is oddly close, and every day he's left with his heart pounding and his head spinning—!? A sweet and sugary "commute-time romcom" that begins with the brief moments before the train arrives!♪

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

I ran into my first love from high school by chance. He was so neat and innocent… my senior. If my memory serves me right, I think he liked me, too. But from the past until now, for “some reason,” we haven’t dated. And I’m curious to know what that reason is.

(Source: Naver, translated)

219779.description:
A new legend of the Shinsengumi is etched into another world!!

May 30, 1868. Okita Souji, former captain of the Shinsengumi's First Unit, dies of illness. The swordsman, hailed as the strongest of the late Edo period, ended his short life not on the battlefield, but in his bed.

—And that's how this man was reincarnated into another world where people fight with magic!? Okita was reincarnated as a boy named Rikuru, who was physically weak and neglected by his family because he didn't possess any magical abilities. Despite his unhappy circumstances, he found happiness in being able to move his body. Aiming to train his body and become stronger, Okita overwhelms those who mock him with his natural swordsmanship. Amidst all this, Okita realizes that there's a possibility that other members of the Shinsengumi have also been reincarnated. "This time, I want to fight alongside everyone in the Shinsengumi until the very end," Okita thinks, when a certain person appears before him...?

The genius swordsman, Okita Souji, slashes through otherworldly magic!!

(Source: Jitsugyo no Nihon Sha, translated)

219780.description:
I'm Sota. No romantic experience, just your typical nerdy, socially awkward high school boy... or at least, I was. Wait, you're wondering if I lost my virginity and became a popular guy? Nope, not even close. I'm not a high school boy anymore—I'm a ghost. That's right. I went from being a socially awkward, nerdy virgin to... well, a former human ghostly virgin. I don't remember much about my previous life, but the one thing I do know is that I died a virgin. Yeah, I'm pretty sure that's my unfinished business. To make things worse, I can't leave this all-girls' school, so now I'm stuck as a spirit, wandering the halls like some kind of low-tier ghost. At first, I thought it wasn't all that bad—since I'm invisible, I get to see the girls in ways I never dared dream of when I was alive. Not gonna lie, I felt a little guilty, but hey, being a ghost isn't that bad! Then one day, I noticed a keychain of my favorite anime character lying on the floor. When I tried to pick it up—"Why is there a boy in our school?" That's when I met her—a cute, kind, and popular girl who's friends with everyone. Somehow, she's the only one who can see me, the ghost that I've become. And to make things worse—or better—I think I've fallen for her, a girl who's totally out of my league...

(Source: Manga Mirai)

219781.description:
“Please use me however you like as your model. I’ll do whatever you say.”

“Let’s make an e*ge together!”

Noelle, usually a cool and composed French beauty, is secretly a hardcore eroge otaku. One day, high schooler Masato is suddenly asked by her to draw illustrations for an eroge! Masato is used to drawing, but he’s never been good at drawing anything lewd…

“Please use me however you like as your model. I’ll do whatever you say, okay?”

As a start, Masato begins drawing Noelle as his model after she takes off her panties… Developing an eroge alone with a beautiful girl in a mixed-use building in Akihabara!?

A steamy creator rom-com where passion and eroticism intersect!

219782.description:
A slightly offbeat slice-of-life comedy starring… a golem schoolgirl?!

It’s spring of his second year in high school, and Otonashi can’t help but notice the girl sitting next to him, cheerful, bright, and, well… a golem. Her arm pops off at the drop of a hat, flowers sprout from her head when she’s happy, and she overheats whenever she’s embarrassed. Every day with her brings something new and unexpected. Not quite a romance, but definitely not your average friendship... here begins the surreal, slightly strange daily life of two unusual classmates.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

219783.description: Leti is a young noblewoman who has been called cursed and confined to her room in the manor she lives in. But just as Leti is set to be married off in an unwanted marriage, a mysterious group called The Traveling Informants appears and puts a stop to it. Granted her freedom by the mysterious people, Leti sets off on a journey with them to learn more about the world. What will she see, and what will she gain? That all depends on her!

Late one night, while out for a walk with his beloved dog, Moko, a novelist named Osawa discovers a mobile café—from which the rich aroma of coffee drifts. Though initially taken aback by the outgoing and talkative owner, Hagiwara, Osawa finds himself drawn in by the man’s gentle smile—and the stirrings of a new, romantic affection. As the days pass, the two grow ever closer; yet, having reached the age of 32 without ever experiencing love, Osawa finds himself unable to take that final, decisive step…

(Source: Tokyo Mangasha, translated)

219790.description:
“Talking on the phone… it’s kind of like we’re talking right into each other’s ears. It really gets your heart racing, doesn’t it?”

At school, I’m the silent guy, Mukuhara Chiyuu. I really want to talk more, but my “Mukuchi-kun” persona is so established that I can’t. But I have a secret pleasure I look forward to! During my free time at home in the evenings, I open my phone and post, “Looking for a voice call.” My account, which is a little popular for having a hot voice, immediately gets an invitation via DM. My call partner is a cute girl my age! We click so well and it’s a ton of fun, and our back-and-forth feels so much like a new couple’s that it makes my heart pound a little.

…But this voice, the topics we discuss, they seem kind of familiar? Am I imagining it? No, but still… could it really be the beautiful, athletic, and admirable ace student in my class, Yoshino-san!? It doesn’t seem like she’s realized who I am, though…?

A nonstop, love comedy bursting with desire begins, featuring Sumisaka, whose pure nature leads her wild fantasies, and Tsukishiro, who is a bit of an airhead!

219799.description:
Shidou could see things that he calls "seeds of misfortune" ever since he was a child. It is something like a sticky shadow, and when he doesn't do anything, it brings misfortune to people. He always smashes it with his hand to eliminate them, counting the number as "virtue points". Shidou wishes to pile up good karma so that someday his "curse" will be lifted, and he will stop seeing nightmares.

One day, he finds a monster too powerful for him to handle... but tries anyway to save people. There he meets Mashiro, who knows a proper way to fight with the monster. He is an Onmyouji... who is in charge of bringing harmony to this world. Mashiro is immediately aware that Shidou has a special talent, that they'll be the most powerful pair!

(Source: Kadokawa)
